children: fell 1.23% premarket after Morgan Stanley downgraded it to Underweight from Equal-weight, keeping a 250 DKK target that implies more than 10% downside. Analysts led by Thibault Boutherin wrote that the valuation does not entirely reflect subdued mid-term growth or "the implications of the semaglutide patent cliff on Novo's terminal value." The shares fell 2% in Copenhagen trading.

Semaglutide, the ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, accounted for 75% of sales in 2026 and Morgan Stanley models it still at 59% in 2031, when loss of exclusivity starts to bite across Europe and the US. The bank sees the oral obesity franchise reaching $10 billion by 2031, which it says won't offset pricing and competitive headwinds. Its forecast is 2% to 3% revenue and EBIT growth in 2027 and a 4% compound annual rate through 2030, against 4% revenue and 7% EBIT growth for European pharma generally.

Novo trades at 12.5x 2027 estimated earnings, a 7% discount to European large pharma but a 35% premium to global peers with their own exclusivity problems, with Sanofi at 8x and GSK at 10x. A Morgan Stanley survey of 200 primary care physicians pointed to share losses to Eli Lilly Inc.
over the next 18 months, including retatrutide expected in 2027.

title: Novo Nordisk Stock Falls as Morgan Stanley Doubts the Offset
